deduplication.comparison_tokenization: Unicode word tokens, casefolded; punctuation and whitespace ignored for comparison only
deduplication.paragraph_candidate_method: exhaustive shared-shingle inverted index with a necessary length-ratio bound
limitations: This is a deterministic lexical screen, not proof that semantic duplicates or contamination are absent.
Every cross-document paragraph pair that shares a shingle and can satisfy the threshold by length is checked with exact hashed-shingle Jaccard.
Only cross-document paragraphs with the configured minimum word count are screened.
